readme:
# AlignProp 去噪链的截断奖励反传

## 1. 问题

实现一个可控制梯度起点的 DDIM 采样链，让终点奖励穿过指定的去噪后缀反传。

调用传入的小型 epsilon 模型，练习时间方向和梯度截断；不实现 LoRA 或 checkpoint 内存优化。

## 2. 核心公式

$$
\hat x_0^{(i)}=(x_i-\sigma_i\epsilon_\theta(x_i,i))/\alpha_i,\quad x_{i+1}=\alpha_{i+1}\hat x_0^{(i)}+\sigma_{i+1}\epsilon_\theta(x_i,i).
$$

## 3. 公式到代码

```python
reward_rollout(initial: Tensor, alphas: Tensor, sigmas: Tensor, denoiser, backprop_from: int) -> Tensor
```

按执行顺序遍历调度器，先预测噪声再还原干净样本，再构造下一个噪声级。指定起点之前使用 no_grad；到起点只截断一次状态，后缀内部保留整条链式法则。

## 4. 本题约定

initial (B,D); alphas/sigmas equal vectors of length T+1 in execution order noisy-to-clean, amplitudes alpha>0, sigma>=0. denoiser(x,step) returns same shape. backprop_from in [0,T-1] specifies first differentiable transition. Terminal schedule is caller-supplied.

Initial noise and schedules are frozen. Prefix transitions execute without gradients; suffix transitions retain all recurrent state and model paths.

## 5. 交互图与实验

实验使用你提交的函数。图中各点来自实际运行结果。

A four-step DDIM chain with a scalar epsilon bias is trained for 45 updates on a quadratic terminal target; every rollout uses the submitted truncation routine.

## 6. 在网页中运行

在右侧 Python 编辑器中补全实现，点击 **运行测试**。查看失败测试的原因、期望值与实际值，修改代码后再次运行。所有必要测试通过后，题目会标记为已完成并解锁坑点讲解。

## 7. 延伸

对不同后缀长度实测梯度偏差与存储需求。

[Aligning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with Reward Backpropagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.03739) · Method: reward backpropagation; official sd_pipeline.py backprop_timestep
notes:
# 题解与常见错误

按执行顺序遍历调度器，先预测噪声再还原干净样本，再构造下一个噪声级。指定起点之前使用 no_grad；到起点只截断一次状态，后缀内部保留整条链式法则。

$$
\hat x_0^{(i)}=(x_i-\sigma_i\epsilon_\theta(x_i,i))/\alpha_i,\quad x_{i+1}=\alpha_{i+1}\hat x_0^{(i)}+\sigma_{i+1}\epsilon_\theta(x_i,i).
$$

Initial noise and schedules are frozen. Prefix transitions execute without gradients; suffix transitions retain all recurrent state and model paths.

若每步都 detach，前几个后缀步骤无法收到终点奖励。截断只改变梯度，不应改变前向采样值。调度器给的是振幅，不应重复开平方。

测试依据：恒定噪声模型的手算链、不同截断的前向一致性、独立标量递推导数和前缀梯度零。

## 实验标定

固定种子 42，CPU float64，直接梯度下降；无需数据下载。以下是参考解实际测量，不是预设轨迹。 PyTorch 2.14.1. lr=.05 (45 updates).

```json
{"final": 4.760992065567561e-13, "initial": 1.0, "updates": 45}
```

验收阈值见 `tests/test_core.py::test_real_toy_experiment`；基线为训练前参数的实际输出。

en.readme:
# AlignProp Truncated Reward Backpropagation

## 1. Problem

Implement a DDIM sampling chain whose terminal reward differentiates through a selected denoising suffix.

Call a supplied small epsilon model to study time direction and gradient truncation; LoRA and activation checkpointing are outside scope.

## 2. Core equations

$$
\hat x_0^{(i)}=(x_i-\sigma_i\epsilon_\theta(x_i,i))/\alpha_i,\quad x_{i+1}=\alpha_{i+1}\hat x_0^{(i)}+\sigma_{i+1}\epsilon_\theta(x_i,i).
$$

## 3. From equations to code

```python
reward_rollout(initial: Tensor, alphas: Tensor, sigmas: Tensor, denoiser, backprop_from: int) -> Tensor
```

Traverse the schedule in execution order, recover a clean estimate and form the next noise level. Run the prefix without gradients and detach the boundary once; preserve the complete chain rule within the suffix.

## 4. Contract

initial (B,D); alphas/sigmas equal vectors of length T+1 in execution order noisy-to-clean, amplitudes alpha>0, sigma>=0. denoiser(x,step) returns same shape. backprop_from in [0,T-1] specifies first differentiable transition. Terminal schedule is caller-supplied.

Initial noise and schedules are frozen. Prefix transitions execute without gradients; suffix transitions retain all recurrent state and model paths.

## 5. Visualization and experiment

The experiment calls your submitted functions; plotted points are measured results.

A four-step DDIM chain with a scalar epsilon bias is trained for 45 updates on a quadratic terminal target; every rollout uses the submitted truncation routine.

## 6. Run your implementation

Complete the functions in the Python editor on the right, then click **Run tests**. Inspect each failed check, update your implementation, and run again. Passing every required check marks the problem as solved and unlocks the notes.

## 7. Extensions

Measure gradient bias and memory requirements for different suffix lengths.

[Aligning Text-to-Image Diffusion Models with Reward Backpropagation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.03739) · Method: reward backpropagation; official sd_pipeline.py backprop_timestep
en.notes:
# Solution reasoning and pitfalls

Traverse the schedule in execution order, recover a clean estimate and form the next noise level. Run the prefix without gradients and detach the boundary once; preserve the complete chain rule within the suffix.

$$
\hat x_0^{(i)}=(x_i-\sigma_i\epsilon_\theta(x_i,i))/\alpha_i,\quad x_{i+1}=\alpha_{i+1}\hat x_0^{(i)}+\sigma_{i+1}\epsilon_\theta(x_i,i).
$$

Initial noise and schedules are frozen. Prefix transitions execute without gradients; suffix transitions retain all recurrent state and model paths.

Detaching every step removes earlier suffix gradients. Truncation must change derivatives without changing forward samples. Schedule values are amplitudes, not variances.

Test basis: Hand-computed constant-epsilon chains, forward equality across truncations, independent scalar derivative recurrence and zero prefix gradients.

## Experiment calibration

Seed 42, CPU float64, direct gradient descent, no downloaded data. Values below were measured from the reference, not a preset trajectory. PyTorch 2.14.1. lr=.05 (45 updates).

```json
{"final": 4.760992065567561e-13, "initial": 1.0, "updates": 45}
```

Acceptance thresholds are in `tests/test_core.py::test_real_toy_experiment`; the baseline is the measured output before training.
